semantics.denominators: Original total cells travel as evidence. SH housing percentages use dwellings in buildings with residential space; heating preserves separate building and dwelling totals. MV sex-specific percentage denominators use male/female totals, not overall population.
semantics.percentageRepresentation: Shared nativePercentValue applies exact x100 display scaling only to numeric source cells with an active OOXML percentage number-format section. General numerics, inline strings, quoted/escaped percent signs and disclosure markers remain unscaled. No <=1 heuristic or header-based scale inference. Original raw lexeme and original number-format metadata are separately evidenced.
semantics.evidenceRoles: Primary evidence contains the original value cell only. ARS locators use municipality_join supporting evidence. Titles, denominator/header cells and actual OOXML number-format style paths use source_metadata supporting evidence. Style locators carry sheet:null,rowKey:null,cells:[] and the shared style mapping version.
semantics.confidentiality: Cell-Key perturbation and source disclosure/quality markers retained verbatim. Parenthesized values and dash/slash/dot/blank markers are null, never coerced to zero or reconstructed. Percentages are not recomputed and totals are not forcibly reconciled.
semantics.populationTotals: SH Insgesamt nachrichtlich and Insgesamta are separate source roles; source note reports incomplete processing in 163 municipalities nationally, without assuming any pilot affected.
semantics.heating: Solar-/Geothermie, Wärmepumpen remains a grouped category, not a heat-pump-only count. Fernwärme is census-reported energy context, not operator, adoption or present supply evidence.
semantics.geography: Native ARS remains exact raw cell evidence; AGS strings preserve leading zeros; district/state/grid values are not disaggregated.
semantics.withdrawal: Missing links in a landing snapshot are not a tombstone. Discovery returns not_checked, never municipal empty or withdrawn claims.
